title: Text Statistics — Word Count, Character Count and Keyword Frequency

content.intro: Word count is the starting point for every piece of writing. The Text Statistics tool goes beyond a single number — it reports characters, words, lines, sentences and paragraphs, and lists how often each word and each character appears, so you can see the shape of your text rather than just its length.

sections.heading: Everything We Count
sections.body: Words: the total number of words, split on whitespace and punctuation. Characters: every character in the text, including spaces and line breaks. Lines: the number of lines, with an option to ignore empty ones. Sentences: counted by the delimiters you choose — the default treats . , ! ? as sentence ends, and you can set your own. Paragraphs: counted by line breaks. Word frequency: the most-used words with how often each appears. Character frequency: the same breakdown for individual characters.

sections.heading: SEO Writing with Word Count
sections.body: Google prefers comprehensive content — most top-ranking pages are 1,500-2,500 words. But quality > quantity. Use the tool to hit minimums (300 words to avoid 'thin content' flags) and check if your content is competitive in length for its topic.

sections.heading: Social Media Character Limits
sections.body: Twitter/X: 280 characters. LinkedIn: 3,000 characters for posts, 700 for company page updates. Instagram captions: 2,200 characters (truncated after 125). Meta descriptions: 155-160 characters. The character count helps you stay within limits before you publish.

sections.heading: How to Use the Text Statistics Tool
sections.body: Paste or type your text. The counts update as you type, and the frequency tables show which words and characters dominate. No signup, no limits — just paste and count.

content.conclusion: Whether you're writing a tweet, a blog post, or a thesis, word count matters. Craftisle's free Text Counter gives you all the metrics you need in one clean, real-time interface.

keyTakeaways: The Text Statistics tool reports words, characters, lines, sentences and paragraphs at once.
Word and character frequency tables reveal which terms dominate your text.
Sentence delimiters are configurable, so you can match your own editorial rules.
Everything runs in your browser — pasted text is never uploaded.
No signup and no usage limit.
